{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for missing values
missing_values = trial_df.isnull().sum()
print(missing_values)

# Check for sentinel values
sentinel_values = trial_df.apply(lambda x: x.isin([-999, -999.0, -999.00]).sum())
print(sentinel_values)

# Check value counts of key categorical variables
print("\nArm distribution:")
print(trial_df['arm'].value_counts())

print("\nSeverity distribution:")
print(trial_df['severity'].value_counts())

print("\nSite distribution:")
print(trial_df['site'].value_counts())

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = trial_df.duplicated().sum()
print(f"\nNumber of duplicate rows: {duplicates}")

# Check distributions of biomarker_baseline and biomarker_final
print("\nBiomarker baseline - summary:")
print(trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].describe())

print("\nBiomarker final - summary:")
print(trial_df['biomarker_final'].describe())"}
